units.source_text: 然而，我决不在行动上有所败露，譬如向老师暗示这些学费的用途。

en.t: However, I never let anything show in my actions, such as hinting to the teacher what I was using the tuition money for.

units.source_text: 不须自白，因为即使不坦白，老师也会探听出来的。

en.t: There was no need to confess, because even if I did not speak frankly, the teacher would find it out anyway.
